lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A systematic arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into five primary horizontal rows extending posteriorly across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at regular intervals, forming a geometric grid-like lattice where spots act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from high pixel intensity on the superior surface to shadow-derived low intensity on the inferior surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A single elongated dark feature, representing an attached remora, is visible on the mid-lateral flank between the central and upper carinae.
